name: my-stake
description: MonoRepo with TypeScript (client, ws-gateway) and Java (server)

scripts.install:all: cd server && mvn clean install && pnpm install
scripts.build: pnpm -r build && cd server && mvn clean package
scripts.dev:all: concurrently "pnpm --filter client dev" "pnpm --filter ws-gateway dev" "cd server && mvn spring-boot:run"
scripts.clean: pnpm -r exec rm -rf dist build node_modules .next && cd server && mvn clean && rm -rf target
